name: Jawa Classic 300
description: Timeless retro cruiser featuring a responsive 293cc liquid-cooled engine and twin exhausts. Offers unmatched highway comfort for road trips toward Kumbhalgarh Fort and Nathdwara.

name: Vespa Elegante 150
description: Classic Italian retro styling with smooth automatic transmission. Ideal for romantic lakefront evening cruises along Fateh Sagar, Rani Road, and Saheliyon-ki-Bari.

name: Honda Activa 6G
description: Effortless, fuel-efficient city scooter perfect for navigating Udaipur's old city streets, Lake Pichola, and colorful bazaars. Features smooth combi-braking and comfortable seating with complimentary sanitized helmets.

name: Yamaha R15 V4
description: Aerodynamic sports supersport with Variable Valve Actuation (VVA), upside-down front forks, and dual-channel ABS for maximum cornering grip and track-level stability.

name: Bajaj Pulsar NS200
description: Raw muscle and agile perimeter frame engineering. Built for thrilling hill climbs to Sajjangarh Monsoon Palace and scenic mountain trails around Rayta Hills.

name: BMW G 310 GS
description: Premium adventure tourer engineered by BMW Motorrad. Generous suspension travel, 19-inch front wheel, and upright ergonomics ready for rugged Rajasthan expeditions.

name: Ather 450X Gen 3
description: High-torque, zero-emission smart electric scooter with instant throttle response and built-in touchscreen navigation. Cruise silently around the lakes with 105 km true range per charge.

name: TVS Jupiter 125
description: Spacious metal body scooter with all-in-one external front fuel fill, largest-in-segment 33L under-seat storage, and progressive front disc brake for effortless family cruising in Udaipur.

name: Yamaha Aerox 155
description: Maxi-sports scooter powered by a 155cc liquid-cooled engine with Variable Valve Actuation (VVA). Features wide 140mm radial rear tire, negative LCD digital cluster, and supreme cockpit comfort.

name: TVS Ntorq 125 Race XP
description: Stealth aircraft inspired styling with dual ride modes (Race & Street) and Bluetooth turn-by-turn navigation on the digital cluster. Peppy acceleration for quick city commutes.

name: TVS iQube S Electric
description: Silent, highly reliable family electric scooter with 100 km real-world range, 7-inch TFT touchscreen display, and plush dual suspension for smooth, zero-emission city exploration.

name: Yamaha MT-15 V2
description: Hyper-naked streetfighter with bi-functional LED headlight, golden upside-down (USD) front forks, and aggressive low-end torque delivery for sharp city maneuvering and evening rides.

name: KTM RC 390
description: Track-bred supersport machine with factory clip-on handlebars, aerodynamic Grand Prix fairing, power-assisted slipper clutch, and cornering ABS for high-speed highway precision.

name: Royal Enfield Classic 350 Reborn
description: The iconic thump reborn on the J-series chassis. Dual-channel ABS, vibration-free counterbalanced engine, and wide touring saddle for timeless Udaipur lake and heritage palace exploration.

name: Royal Enfield Hunter 350
description: Nimble, modern-retro roadster cruiser with retro-metro dual-tone paintwork, lower seat height, and flickable handling through narrow heritage city alleys.

name: Royal Enfield Himalayan 450
description: Built for all roads and no roads. Powered by the liquid-cooled Sherpa 450 engine, long-travel Showa inverted suspension, and full-color round Tripper navigation dash for epic expeditions.

name: Hero XPulse 200 4V
description: Lightweight dual-sport trail conqueror with 220mm high ground clearance, rally-style windshield, aluminum bash plate, and spoke wheels for Sajjangarh hill climbs and off-road trails.
